Group Risk Management Policy

GRP-POL-001|Version6.0|Internal

## 16.Incident and loss event management

## 16.1Reporting obligation

All incidents, near misses and loss events must be reported by the individual who becomes aware of them, through the Group Incident Management System, no later than the end of the next business day. The obligation is not contingent on knowing the cause, the extent of loss, or whether the event will prove material. Failure to report a known incident is a breach of this policy. Near misses are reported on the same basis: st event that caused no loss only because of chance carries the same learning value as one that did.

16.2 Severity classification

| SEVERITY | INDICATIVECRITERIA | INITIALNOTIFICATION | GOVERNANCE |
|---|---|---|---|
| Severity 1 | Sustainedoutage ofan importantbusiness service:materialcustomerdetriment: suspected material regulatorybreach: confirmed data breach | M.T.Achebe (+1 212 555-0147)and theCEO within1 hour | CrisisManagementTeamconvened;Board notified within24 hours |
| Severity 2 | Significant servicedegradation; contained data incident; loss above the High threshold | DivisionalCEoandGroupRiskwithin 4 hours | Group ExecutiveRiskCommittee at nextmeeting |
| Severity 3 | Localised disruption; limited customer impact;loss above the Elevated threshold | Business unithead within 1business day | DivisionalRiskCommittee |
| Severity 4 | near miss |  | Reviewed inaggregate monthly |

## 16.3 Response lifecycle

1. Detect and report — record the event with the facts known at the time.

2. Triage and classify—assign severity,taxonomy category and an incident manager.

3. Contain — limit further impact; containment takes precedence over investigation.

4. Notify — internal escalation per 16.2 and regulatory notification assessment per 16.6.

5. Recover — restore service and confirm restoration is stable.

6. Investigate — establish root cause through structured analysis, not assertion.

7. Remediate — raise issues and actions under Section 15.

8. Review — post-incident review for all Severity 1 and 2 events, within 20 business days.

9. Learn — share findings and update the register, RCSA and KRIs as appropriate.
